يحسس (form I)
# يَحْسُسْ (yaḥsus) /jaħ.sus/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”)
# يُحْسَسْ (yuḥsas) /juħ.sas/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”) and حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to feel, to perceive”)
# يَحْسِسْ (yaḥsis) /jaħ.sis/: third-person masculine singular non-pa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
